note: which input files decide_v1 may read: each must be named (by sha16) in its library's signed release record, or in a receipt that release names. A field's library status column, where the library has one, must hold an admitted status. Context V4.1: CANDIDATE fields are the ones its release admits for research; NOT_PROVEN and RETROSPECTIVE_METADATA are refused. Profile V5.1 and pre-move V1.2 cards carry no field status column.
